_readme: The bundled floor: local runtimes, which no public catalogue lists, plus the two hosted vendors whose base URL only their SDK knows (models.dev omits `api` for them). Every other hosted vendor is derived from models.dev at refresh time and cached in $NOVA_HOME/provider_presets.cache.json, so adding one needs neither a release nor a row here. A row here always wins over a derived one.

presets.label: Ollama (local)
presets.note: Runs on this machine. No API key.

presets.label: LM Studio (local)
presets.note: Local OpenAI-compatible server. No API key unless yours requires one.

presets.label: OpenAI
presets.note: models.dev states no base URL for this one; the adapter default is used.

presets.label: Anthropic
presets.note: models.dev states no base URL for this one; the adapter default is used.

presets.label: OpenCode Go
presets.note: models.dev points this at /inference/go/openai/v1, which answers 404; this is the checked one.
